meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计出规范高效的Postgres表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计或审查Postgres表结构,并希望用上实践验证过的方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing PostgreSQL table schemas and want practical guidance.

howto.what: 当你说要设计或审查 PostgreSQL 的表结构时，Claude 会套用这套规范给出建议：主键与数据类型选择、约束与索引配置、是否分区，并附上示例 SQL。
howto.when: 当你想设计或复查 PostgreSQL 建表方案时触发，比如讨论字段类型、主键/索引、分区，或要求“帮我优化表结构”等。

say.text: 帮我设计一张 PostgreSQL 用户表，包含邮箱和注册时间。
请审查这段建表 SQL，指出索引和约束的问题。
say.note: Claude 会对照规则逐条检查并给出修改建议。

say.text: 这张千万级订单表，如何按时间分区？
say.note: Claude 会给出 RANGE 分区方案及分区键建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to design or review a PostgreSQL table schema, Claude will follow this skill's built-in rules to recommend primary keys, data types, indexes, constraints, and partitioning, with sample SQL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design or review a PostgreSQL-specific schema, e.g. choosing column types, keys, constraints, indexes, partitioning, or optimizing a table design.

say_en.text: Design a PostgreSQL users table with email and created_at.
say_en.note: Returns a suggested CREATE TABLE statement.

say_en.text: Review this schema SQL for index and constraint issues.
How should I partition a 10-million-row orders table by time?
